dominant_strengths: Clean hierarchy with section labels (MAIN, WORKSPACE), nested project list, and consistent icon-label rhythm reads instantly
Restrained palette of slate/indigo with a single accent on Overview gives clear active-state signaling without noise
Thoughtful affordances: ⌘K hint, badge counts, NEW pill, and user footer with plan tier feel production-grade
dominant_weaknesses: Aesthetic is highly conventional Linear/Vercel-clone territory — nothing distinctive in layout, iconography, or interaction language
Empty canvas dominates the frame; the right-side instructional card feels like a placeholder rather than a designed empty state
Nested project items use faint dashes that read as low-contrast noise, weakening the otherwise tight typographic system
fix_priorities: Introduce a signature interaction or visual motif (collapse animation, hover preview) to differentiate from generic SaaS sidebars
Redesign the empty main area into an intentional dashboard or onboarding moment, not an instruction card
Replace dash-prefixed nested items with a proper indent guide or tree affordance for cleaner hierarchy
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral execution is strong and legible, visceral impression is competent but familiar, and reflective payoff is muted by lack of identity.
rationale.intent_fit: It delivers a polished improved sidebar-nav, but 'improved' here means refined-conventional rather than meaningfully reimagined.
